name: Atomic Physics
summary: The structure and spectra of atoms, from hydrogen fine structure to multi-electron atoms in external fields.

topics.name: The hydrogen atom revisited: energy levels and wavefunctions
Fine structure: spin-orbit coupling and relativistic corrections
The Lamb shift and QED corrections (overview)
Atoms in magnetic fields: Zeeman and Paschen-Back effects
Atoms in electric fields: the Stark effect
Multi-electron atoms: central-field approximation and Hartree-Fock
LS and jj coupling, term symbols and Hund's rules
Radiative transitions, selection rules and lifetimes
Exotic atoms: positronium and muonic atoms
